title: NERV: Local LLM Agent Orchestrator
description: Splits one query into typed subtasks, routes each to the local model best suited to it (a code model for debugging, a general model for explanation), runs them in dependency order and merges the results. Planner output is Pydantic-validated with retry and a safe fallback, routing is deterministic and unit-tested, and a 20-task harness benchmarks the whole thing against a single model, because orchestration costs extra LLM calls and has to earn them. Ollama only, no cloud APIs.
